review.description: S1-S4 subscription verification, stable identities, bounded retries, disabled-delivery progress and metadata-only PR/attention alerts are unchanged. Material-review questions reuse the existing attention event route without adding a notification payload or subscription kind.
review.implementation: Compared main notification contract and unchanged event delivery implementation. Review gates publish normal attention metadata and saved-state changes use a separate metadata-only UI journal. Neither new review artifacts nor private rules are inserted into host notification bodies.
review.tests: Read TestPRMonitoringAndRecoveredQuestionsUseMetadataOnlyNotifications: private context is placed in originating events, resulting bodies omit it, and two ticks deliver exactly one inbox and one attention notification. Existing callback safety/retry/dedup/expiry assertions remain declared; actual host signed-alert timing remains an explicit unverified scenario.
